  • Method Details

    • run

      public void run()
      Executes the initialization process for the application by performing the following operations: 1. Calls addUsers() to add default users to the application. This ensures that the system contains a minimum set of predefined users with specific roles. 2. Calls createMap() to create and add predefined maps to the map repository. This step ensures that the application has a predefined set of maps required for gameplay scenarios. 3. Calls createScenario() to create scenarios associated with the predefined maps. These scenarios include various restrictions, budgets, and locomotive types relevant to the simulation. 4. Calls gameLocomotives() to add defined locomotives into the system repository. This ensures that all available locomotives are ready for the simulation each time the application starts. This method is intended to be the entry point for initializing the system, ensuring that all necessary components and data are preloaded for proper application functionality.
      Specified by:
      run in interface Runnable

    • addUsers

      public void addUsers()
      Adds default users to the system using the AuthenticationController. This method creates two predefined users: 1. An editor with the role "EDITOR". 2. A player with the role "PLAYER". The added users are intended for initial testing or setup purposes and can be utilized in various parts of the application where these roles are required. Preconditions: - The AuthenticationController must be properly initialized and connected to the authentication repository. Postconditions: - Two users with the specified roles, names, emails, and passwords are created and stored in the system's authentication repository.

    • createMap

      public Optional<Map> createMap()
      Creates and adds multiple predefined maps to the map repository. After adding the maps, it retrieves and returns a specific map from the repository with the name "ExampleMap" if it exists.
      Returns:
      an Optional<Map> containing the map with the name "ExampleMap" if it is found in the repository, or an empty Optional if it is not found.

    • createScenario

      public void createScenario()
      Creates and assigns predefined scenarios to all available maps in the repository. This method performs the following tasks: 1. Retrieves instances of ScenarioRepository and MapRepository. 2. Defines a list of predefined scenarios, each with specific restrictions, budgets, and locomotive types. The predefined scenarios do not have an associated map initially. 3. Retrieves all maps from the MapRepository. 4. Iterates over all the maps and associates each map with every predefined scenario. For each map, it creates a new Scenario by appending the map's name to the base scenario name, assigns the map, and uses the same restrictions and budget from the base scenario. 5. Adds each newly created scenario to the respective map and stores it in the ScenarioRepository. Preconditions: - The repositories must be properly initialized and accessible via the Repositories class. Postconditions: - Each map in the repository will have a set of associated scenarios based on the predefined list. - The newly created scenarios will be added to both the map and the scenario repository.

    • gameLocomotives

      public void gameLocomotives()
      This method is responsible to add every locomotive available on the simulator to the repository, everytime the simulation starts.
